title: Can the discovery engine generate testable follow-up hypotheses?
description: Runs PhenomenonDetector across CASE A's seeds, groups recurring phenomena into hypotheses, and generates (but does not execute) a follow-up experiment proposal.
statistical_plan: recurrence across >= 2 independent seeds (no significance test)
limitations: 'NOT_TESTED' here means hypotheses were generated but the generated follow-up experiment itself was not executed — the pipeline runs end-to-end, but the loop was not closed with a real follow-up run.
